pages.title: Giant Wildebeest
pages.text: $(o)Megalotragus$() ($(o)Megalotragus priscus$()), the giant wildebeest, lived in southern Africa during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It stood about 1.5 metres at the shoulder, with a long face and very long horns that swept out and back.$(br2)It survived until the end of the last ice age, about 12,000 years ago.
